The assistant is stuck because it keeps not providing final answer. Need to output final answer with correct tags. Provide thought then final answer.

The answer: list of lists with the precursor SMILES.

Thus:

<thought>We have applied the template and obtained the precursor SMILES ...</thought>
<final_answer>[[\"C=C(C)C(=O)O[C@@]1(C(F)(F)F)CCC[C@H]1C(=C)c1ccccc1\"]]</final_answer>

Make sure JSON-like list of lists. Use double quotes inside.
